working at a particular job.ex: Ravi is working at a bank job in Delhi.

working hard.ex: Priya is working hard for her maths test.

working reluctantly.mean: doing job without interest or wish
working reluctantly.ex: Rohit is working reluctantly in the hot sun.

working slowly and lazily.mean: doing job very slow and lazy
working slowly and lazily.ex: The boy is working slowly and lazily in class.

working under a cruel master.mean: job with a very bad boss
working under a cruel master.ex: The servant is working under a cruel master.

working very hard.ex: Meena is working very hard for her family.

wright.mean: a person who builds or makes things
wright.ex: A wheelwright makes wheels for bullock carts.
